title: Trace the Two Demonstrated Workloads
status: Timed to measured final narration and forced character alignment

scenes.cue: The draft demonstrates two proof-of-concept integrations.
scenes.visual: Opening paired operand cards: GEMV resident matrix and vector search resident index. Explicit Proof-of-concept integrations badge; restrained transition into inference.
Inference scene. Host with LLaMA 3.2-1B / ExecuTorch. Selected GEMV path reveals CPU-side library, NDC API and driver. CXL host-device boundary visible.
Resident matrix in device-memory enclosure highlighted; engine adjacent in same device. No matrix packet crosses boundary.

scenes.cue: The host supplies an input vector.
scenes.visual: Input-vector request traverses host-device boundary once; input lands at PNM engine.
Local matrix/engine link activates and GEMV expression resolves to output vector; result then crosses boundary back to host.

scenes.cue: The useful change is the traffic pattern
scenes.visual: Hold completed GEMV path, label matrix reuse and smaller exchanged vectors. Explicit schematic quantities disclaimer.
Explicit new-scene transition to Faiss IVFFlat retrieval. Dataset/index on SSD becomes visible below host before loading.

scenes.cue: An index generated from the vector dataset
scenes.visual: SSD index transfers once into CMM-DC memory. Label setup/load cost; source remains on SSD and resident index appears in device.
Host search request via NDC API travels to PNM engine. Local candidate-search link activates within CMM-DC memory.
Compact result packet returns to host; resident index remains. Candidate vector traffic stays device-local.
Final paired comparison: resident matrix plus GEMV and resident index plus search, each with input and smaller result. Common conclusion: reduced traffic is a hypothesis for system benefit.
Final evidence strip reveals setup, latency, throughput, energy and correctness. Hold completed summary through audio end; no loops or reset.
